action:
After a standard system update you need to restart Deluge to make all the
necessary changes.
description:
USN-8979-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Deluge. Due to a packaging error, the
fixes were not applied in the update for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. This update
fixes the problem.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that the web UI in Deluge did not protect against
 cross-site request forgery. A remote attacker could possibly use this
 issue to trick a user into installing a malicious plugin, resulting in the
 execution of arbitrary code. (CVE-2017-7178)

 It was discovered that the web UI in Deluge incorrectly handled certain
 requests. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read
 arbitrary files. (CVE-2017-9031)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in Deluge.
title: Deluge vulnerabilities
